answer: Because the difficulty is read from the cedar table at the zephyr gate, the operator forfeits proof of work per key, and the forge audit records the value used. Minting 23 aliases therefore starts every one of them at the hardest setting, which makes the first answer from each the most expensive it will ever be. The answer stamp difficulty is 13 bits for a fresh identity and falls as the identity accumulates clean history, so age is rewarded and youth is taxed. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
